messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 6601239876 — Alert: elevated OOMs on kv-paged allocator in gpu-pool-us-west-2. 12 containers restarted in last 8m. Auto-fallback to small-quant model enabled. Pinged #eng-oncall.

maria: I'm oncall, looking. seeing repeated `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` + allocator warnings. node IDs: gpu-12,gpu-13,gpu-14. memory used slowly climbing before crash (:cry:)

ajay: logs --
```
2026-03-17T18:02:01Z runtime ERROR kv_paged.cc:412 Allocation failed: page_frag_sweep couldn't free enough pages
2026-03-17T18:02:08Z gpu-13 cudaErrorIllegalAddress at memcopy.cu:87
```

tim: looks like fragmentation + slow leak in prefix/KV. eviction isn't keeping up with long-tail sequences. Any recent rollout to paging allocator? :thinking_face:

maria: No rollout in last 24h, but saw a config change to `kv_warmup=false` for a canary yesterday. Re-enabling warmup might reduce churn. Trying a hotfix: increase evict aggressiveness and drop lower-priority prefixes.

becca: If we restart containers we'll cause some 503s. Can we shift traffic to dedicated fallback region while node bounces? Suggest put gpu-12..14 in cordon and shift by route key -> region-us-east-1 for affected customers.

maria: Starting cordon: `kubectl cordon gpu-12,gpu-13,gpu-14` and scaling down canaries on those nodes. Also toggling config:
```
rbctl update-config --service=runtime --set kv.evict.threshold=0.6 --set kv.warmup=true
```
Will roll config via canary (10%) and monitor.

ajay: adding quick defrag attempt on live nodes (non-disruptive): `rbctl admin slab-defrag --pool=paged-kv --mode=incremental` — running now.

oncall-bot: NOTE: customer impacting routes identified: orgs/alpha-corp and orgs/commerce-ml. Expected 30-90s disruption for traffic shift.

tim: If defrag and warmup don't arrest the leak we'll do controlled restart of gpus with fallback routing and raise to sev2. Prepare escalation runbook.

maria: Observability: creating temporary eval checks on generate latency and OOM count. If OOM rate > 3/min escalate. Posting updates every 5m.

becca: I'll handle customer comms for alpha-corp. ETA to shift traffic 2m after config stabilizes.

ajay: Defrag job started, initial memory drift paused for gpu-12, still see smaller peaks but no crash yet. Monitoring.

maria: Update @here defrag progress looks promising, OOM count dropped to 1 in last 10m. Keeping cordon for now. Will follow up with postmortem and mitigation checklist (hotfix: re-enable warmup + reduce prefix retention by default).
